title: Anthony Spina, DDS, MD Inducted as FACS
html: Congratulations to Anthony Spina, DDS, MD! Anthony was officially inducted as a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons (FACS) on Saturday, September 26, 2026 in Washington, DC during the Convocation Ceremony of the ACS Clinical Congress 2026! Dr. Spina now joins Dr. Victor Cimino & Dr. Mariusz Wrzosek as a Fellow of ACS. The three oral surgeons have their combined practice Chicago Surgical Specialists in Park Ridge, Illinois. Congratulations!
